name: sc036-artifacts-site-disabled
description: 036 T095 (C3.9) — the SITE-DISABLED withholding class. `attachment/meta` answers `enabled: false` and the whole publication is withheld with one warning, zero writes of every kind, and every artifact reported `withheld` with reason `site-disabled` rather than `published`. Worth its own scenario for a measured reason: jq resolves `false // true` to TRUE, so the Bash port and its shim both read this site state as ENABLED until a case set it — while the PowerShell port, which tests for the property presence, always honoured it. A cross-port divergence on the one path that switches the feature off.
